description: Work out an employee's length of service between a hire date and a date you pick. Send the hire date and the as-of date (and, if you like, your own milestone years such as 1, 5, 10). Get back the service in whole years, months and days, the total days, whether today is a work anniversary, the next anniversary (its date, number and days away), and the date of every milestone year with whether it is passed, today or ahead, plus the next milestone. No name or employee number is asked for. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/tenure-calc). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of_date.description: The date to measure service up to, YYYY-MM-DD; on or after the hire date.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'role band B' (your own text, echoed; not a person's name).

milestone_years.description: Optional: service milestones in years (1 to 80, up to 20). Default 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. Sorted, duplicates dropped.
